music: Bright friendly upbeat pop bed, 120 bpm, no vocals
lines: Here's how to build a whole slide deck in ReStyles.
Drop in the look you want the deck to copy. A slide, a flyer, anything with the right style.
Say what the deck is about, or paste a document. Then build the plan.
Check the plan. Add a slide, move one, or let AI write the points.
Build the deck. Every slide comes back in that look, with your charts and numbers exact.
Fix any slide by chat, then download. A whole deck, in minutes.
